title: Switch to the tagged italia/spid-laravel release
body:
Every published `italia/spid-laravel` up to v2.1.0-beta pins `onelogin/php-saml` 4.1.0 (CVE-2025-66475) and allows Laravel up to 12. The fix is merged upstream in italia/spid-laravel#132 but not tagged yet, so 1.0.0 ships with CI and the README installing the fork branch `offline-agency/spid-laravel:feat/laravel-13`.

Note: upstream `master` points its `extra.patches` URL at the deleted `feat/laravel-13` branch (404). The tag must point it at `master`, the tag or a commit, otherwise the SPID patch is not applied.

Once upstream tags the release:

- [ ] Check the tag's `extra.patches` URL resolves and the patch applies (`vendor/onelogin/php-saml/PATCHES.txt` exists with `COMPOSER_EXIT_ON_PATCH_FAILURE=1`)
- [ ] Re-check that `^2.1.0-beta` in `composer.json` matches the version upstream actually publishes (a 3.0.0 would be excluded) and update `tests/ComposerManifestTest.php`
- [ ] Remove `.github/scripts/use-spid-laravel-fork.sh` and `.github/scripts/tests/use-spid-laravel-fork.test.sh`
- [ ] Remove the "Use the patched italia/spid-laravel" steps and the `COMPOSER: composer.ci.json` env from `run-tests.yml`, `phpstan.yml` and `code-style.yml`
- [ ] Drop the fork section from the README ("1. Prepare composer.json": `repositories` and the `dev-feat/laravel-13 as 2.1.0-beta` require) and from CONTRIBUTING "Local Setup"
- [ ] Update the CHANGELOG note that references the fork / italia/spid-laravel#132
- [ ] Run the fresh-app check from the PR #15 body again (Laravel 12 and 13), installing only what the README says
